# Tractor

## Role

Tractor is an external local-ancestry-aware GWAS tool for admixed cohorts. It
uses local ancestry together with ancestry-specific allele counts and covariates
to estimate ancestry-aware association signals.

## Required Preprocessing

- QCed cohort genotype data and phenotype/covariate metadata.
- Phasing and local-ancestry inference, for example with RFMix.
- Harmonized sample IDs, genome build, chromosome names, alleles, and ancestry
  labels across all intermediate files.

## simitall Boundary

simitall can create benchmark truth, preserve ancestry-tract outputs, validate
input requirements, and generate a run plan. It does not yet install, execute,
or wrap Tractor automatically.

## Reference

- Atkinson et al. (2021): DOI 10.1038/s41588-020-00766-y.
- Official repository: https://github.com/Atkinson-Lab/Tractor
